storeId.description: Identity of the durable engine store that accepted this command, stable across restarts. A group member always carries it; an ordinary receipt carries it only for a request sending `X-Claudexor-Store-Identity: 1`, and it stays absent, meaning unknown, when the store has no identity to give.

jobId.description: Daemon job id backing the run.

at.description: The effective deadline the engine enforces: the run's own or, when earlier, its Delegate parent's current one.

revision.description: Revision of the run's own deadline; a set must name it.

serverNow.description: The server's wall clock when this answer was made.

state.description: armed while the run is live; expired once the deadline ended it; closed after any other terminal.

stopGraceSec.description: Seconds after `at` by which every process inside the run's boundary is gone (see the capability's `boundary`). Work the run handed to another service (a container engine, an already running tmux server, systemd-run) is outside that boundary.

inheritedFrom.description: Job id of the Delegate parent whose deadline is the effective one, or null.

deadline.description: The accepted run-deadline/1 deadline; present only when the request set one.

anyOf.description: Response for a successfully enqueued run.
